subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow fresh-session recook-first fix now, or should it pause until the broader reattach-first behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 is decided?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session duplicate-turn bug, but it intentionally keeps the timeout-style behavior where an accepted gateway run and embedded fallback may both execute; that tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the fresh fallback session as the narrow repair for same-session duplication and leave reattach-first recovery as the separate product issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first
options.body: Make this branch own the broader recovery redesign, reducing duplicate execution but changing stdout and streaming behavior on disconnect.

options.title: Pause in favor of product issue
options.body: Do not land the recook-first repair until maintainers choose the permanent accepted-disconnect recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the fresh fallback session as the narrow repair for same-session duplication and leave reattach-first recovery as the separate product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway-dispatch and agent CLI history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the fallback behavior choice.
